title: The Bidder in the Room
subtitle: A sealed tender that leaked
briefing: A construction contract worth eleven million is awarded to a bidder who undercut the nearest rival by four thousand pounds. The tenders were sealed and held in a safe until the opening. The margin is too fine to be coincidence, and an anonymous complaint alleges the winning bidder saw a rival figure in advance.
solution: Priyanka Basu, the procurement officer, photographed the rival submission during the compliance check that only she performed, and passed the figure through her brother-in-law who works for the winning bidder. The safe access log that implicated the committee chair was a legitimate audit inspection, and the consultant's late-night building entry was for an unrelated project.

suspects.name: Priyanka Basu
suspects.motive: Sole custody of the submissions during the compliance check.

statements.question: Who accessed the safe?
statements.text: Only as logged. The log is the whole point of the log.

statements.question: Describe the compliance check.
statements.text: Standard. Envelopes opened, forms checked for completeness, resealed.

statements.question: Any contact with the bidders?
statements.text: None outside the formal clarification process. That would be improper.

suspects.name: Councillor Ray Hollis
suspects.motive: His access card opened the safe room out of hours.

statements.question: Who accessed the safe?
statements.text: I attended an audit inspection. It was booked, witnessed and minuted.

statements.question: Describe the compliance check.
statements.text: I am not present for that. Members are kept out of it deliberately.

statements.question: Any contact with the bidders?
statements.text: I declared a social contact with one director eight months ago. It is on the register.

suspects.name: Fiona Marr
suspects.motive: Entered the building at 10:40 PM during the tender window.

statements.question: Who accessed the safe?
statements.text: I have no safe access. I am not staff.

statements.question: Describe the compliance check.
statements.text: Not my role. I wrote the specification and left.

statements.question: Any contact with the bidders?
statements.text: I have worked with two of them on other schemes. All declared.

suspects.name: Dermot Quill
suspects.motive: Handled the envelopes between the safe and the committee room.

statements.question: Who accessed the safe?
statements.text: I carry the envelopes, always escorted, always signed.

statements.question: Describe the compliance check.
statements.text: I hand them over and I get them back. I do not open anything.

timeline.text: Tenders are received and placed in the safe.
An image is uploaded from the council network.
An audit inspection accesses the safe.
The winning bid is submitted, four thousand pounds under.

hints: Two people look suspicious and both have paperwork that clears them.
The camera covers the door. Ask what it does not cover.
Follow the image, not the envelope.
